readiness_notes: NNT endpoints (nnt_bp_control, nnt_mace_5yr, nnt_50_pain_relief) are present for every drug in their class but are NESTED dicts {value, ci_95, dose}, not scalars - the typed evidence store must unwrap them (this is the Diabetes 'a1c under nnt_bp_control' collision the review flagged).
Antihypertensive/Diabetes/Anticoagulant have no scalar efficacy endpoint - consistent with the flat-5.0 finding; their data is nested/structured.
Antacid and Alginate have NO efficacy endpoint keys at all - the review's gap; they cannot be ranked on healing.
PPI is the best-evidenced class (7 usable endpoint keys, 5/5 drugs) - supports erosive_esophagitis_healing as the first shipped objective.
Mucosal Protectant has 8-week healing keys (du/gu/gerd) but not the 4-week duodenal endpoint - the horizon mismatch the review flagged.
